## ⚠️ Important Upgrade Notes

- **Embed allowlist:** `APPSMITH_ALLOWED_FRAME_ANCESTORS` must be a list of CSP `frame-ancestors` source expressions. A saved value that is not in that form is served as `'self'` after the next restart. Saving the setting rejects an invalid value. ([#42622](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42622))
- **Git page names:** Git will not commit an app while any page name is not a single path segment. Rename that page first. Creating or renaming a page to such a name is rejected. ([#42633](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42633))

**If you are upgrading from a version before v2.7.0**

- Helm chart: if you set some `probes` keys, the keys you did not set now take the new defaults (10 s period, 5 s timeout). If you tuned `failureThreshold` for the old 60 s period, also set `periodSeconds: 60`. Probe values that are not positive integers now fail `helm install` and `helm upgrade`. Quoted numbers such as `"5"` still work. ([#42571](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42571))
- `navigateTo` to a page name that no longer exists now fails with "Enter a valid URL or page name", even when a parameter value contains a dot. Before, it opened the name as a web address, such as `https://OldPage?file=report.pdf`. A one-word host such as `intranet` with a dotted parameter now fails too. Use a full URL instead. ([#42513](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42513))

## 🔐 Security

- Table CSV downloads no longer let a cell run as a spreadsheet formula. The cell is saved as text. Excel downloads are unchanged. ([#42569](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42569))
- Changing who can use a datasource while validating actions now requires permission to create actions on that datasource. Creating or updating a single action already required this. ([#42601](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42601))
- The frame-ancestors setting accepts only CSP source expressions. An invalid saved value is served as `'self'`. ([#42622](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42622))
- Git writes and deletes stay inside that app's repository. A page name must be a single path segment. ([#42633](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42633))
- Updating a page's dependency map now requires permission to edit that page. ([#42642](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42642))

## 🛠️ Reliability

- OAuth2 authorization-code login now uses the datasource's self-signed certificate for the token exchange. Before, that step ignored the setting, and login failed when the token URL used a private certificate. ([#42605](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42605))
- Importing an app no longer drops a new datasource or JS library when several are created at the same time. ([#42612](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42612))
- MCP keeps an updated query on its own integration. It no longer moves the query onto a datasource of a different type. ([#42620](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42620))
- MCP does not add values to queries on Redshift or Snowflake, because those datasources do not bind parameters. ([#42617](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42617))

## ✨ New Features & Enhancements

- The Filepicker upload dialog follows the app's HTML language. An unsupported or empty language stays in English. ([#42572](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42572))
- MCP structured SQL can bucket dates by day, week, month, quarter, or year on PostgreSQL and Redshift, return up to six aggregates, and select distinct rows. ([#42608](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42608))
- MCP structured SQL can join tables and use CASE and WITH. ([#42619](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42619))
- MCP can copy a stored SQL or REST query to another page, or to another app. The query text stays on the server. ([#42624](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42624))
- MCP can create an email query on an existing SMTP datasource. MCP-built JavaScript can format a date and write a log entry. ([#42638](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42638))

## 🎨 UI & Widget Improvements

- Currency Input adds the Belarusian ruble (BYN), the Venezuelan bolívar (VES), and the Zambian kwacha (ZMW). The older codes BYR, VEF, and ZMK stay in the list. ([#42445](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42445))
- A Button Group with one button keeps its corner radius on every corner. ([#42250](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42250))
- Icon Button and Video controls in a Table cell are 30px tall again, with no extra vertical padding, so the selected number of rows still fits. ([#42615](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42615))
- Pressing Enter in a JSON Form that has one text field and no submit button no longer reloads the page. The Submit button works as before. ([#42607](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42607))
- In a JSON Form, the button Border radius and Box shadow controls highlight the option that is saved. ([#42292](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42292))
- Admin Settings → Branding no longer offers SVG for the instance logo. PNG and JPG are accepted, which is what the server allows. ([#42637](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42637))
use_case: Internal tools, admin panels and database frontends
